<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <FrameLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" android:id="@+id/handheld_root" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="#CC111111">
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/handheld_panel" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:layout_marginHorizontal="20dp" android:layout_marginTop="20dp" android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="20dp" android:background="@drawable/handheld_gradient" >
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:layout_weight="10" android:orientation="vertical" > <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/handheld_bevel_outset_device" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" > <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="0dp" android:orientation="vertical" android:layout_weight="1" style="@style/handheld_device_button_group" > <TextView android:id="@+id/handheld_close_button" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="28dp" android:background="@drawable/handheld_device_button_switch" /> <TextView android:text="I | 0" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" style="@style/handheld_device_label" /> </LinearLayout> </LinearLayout> <TextView android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="0dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:fontFamily="@font/jaro_regular" android:textColor="#AD1F1F" android:textSize="24dp" android:text="NOMACAO" android:gravity="center" /> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" >
<androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="0dp" app:layout_constraintDimensionRatio="1:1" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" android:background="@drawable/handheld_bevel_outset_device" android:padding="@dimen/handheld_offset_15" > <View android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:background="@drawable/handheld_joystick_base" /> <View android:id="@+id/handheld_joystick_head" android:layout_width="64dp" android:layout_height="64dp" android:background="@drawable/handheld_joystick_head" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" /> </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout> </androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout> </LinearLayout>
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/handheld_display" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:orientation="vertical" android:layout_weight="35" android:background="@drawable/handheld_bevel_inset_display" android:layout_marginHorizontal="@dimen/handheld_offset_20" >
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/handheld_tab_row" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="@dimen/handheld_offset_10" >
<TextView android:layout_marginRight="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" android:id="@+id/handheld_evidence_tab" android:text="Evidence" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:padding="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" style="@style/handheld_display_element.inactive" />
<TextView android:layout_marginRight="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" android:id="@+id/handheld_threads_tab" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Threads" android:padding="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" style="@style/handheld_display_element.inactive" />
<TextView android:layout_marginRight="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" android:id="@+id/handheld_timeline_tab" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Timeline" android:padding="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" style="@style/handheld_display_element.inactive" />
<TextView android:layout_marginRight="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" android:id="@+id/handheld_statements_tab" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Statements" android:padding="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" style="@style/handheld_display_element.inactive" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/handheld_final_timeline_tab" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="Final Timeline" android:padding="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" style="@style/handheld_display_element.inactive" /> </LinearLayout>
<ScrollView android:id="@+id/handheld_display_scroll" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="0dp" android:layout_weight="1" android:background="@color/handheld_in_tab_bg">
<LinearLayout android:id="@+id/handheld_display_content_list" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:padding="@dimen/handheld_offset_10" />
</ScrollView>
<TextView android:id="@+id/handheld_current_lead" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content"
android:text="Lead" android:paddingVertical="@dimen/handheld_offset_5" android:paddingHorizontal="@dimen/handheld_offset_10" android:background="@drawable/handheld_bevel_inset_display"
style="@style/handheld_display_element.inactive" />
</LinearLayout> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:layout_weight="10" android:background="@drawable/handheld_bevel_outset_device" android:orientation="vertical" > <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/handheld_back_button" style="@style/handheld_device_button_group.First" > <TextView style="@style/handheld_device_button_group_button.Red" /> <TextView android:text="Go Back" style="@style/handheld_device_label.RightPanel" /> </LinearLayout> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/handheld_up_button" style="@style/handheld_device_button_group" > <TextView style="@style/handheld_device_button_group_button.Black" /> <TextView android:text="Up" style="@style/handheld_device_label.RightPanel" /> </LinearLayout> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/handheld_down_button" style="@style/handheld_device_button_group" > <TextView style="@style/handheld_device_button_group_button.Black" /> <TextView android:text="Down" style="@style/handheld_device_label.RightPanel" /> </LinearLayout> <LinearLayout android:id="@+id/handheld_interact_button" style="@style/handheld_device_button_group.Last" > <TextView style="@style/handheld_device_button_group_button.Red" /> <TextView android:text="Interact" style="@style/handheld_device_label.RightPanel" /> </LinearLayout> </LinearLayout>
</LinearLayout>
</FrameLayout>
